label: Low
meaning: UV is relatively weak compared with higher levels.

label: Moderate
meaning: UV can affect unprotected skin and eyes during outdoor time.

label: High
meaning: Stronger UV can harm unprotected skin and eyes sooner.

label: Very high
meaning: Unprotected skin and eyes can be harmed quickly.

label: Extreme
meaning: The strongest UV levels can harm unprotected skin and eyes very quickly.
